description: This file is a shell script used for creating and partitioning a bootable SD card image for Sunxi hardware within the OpenWrt build system. It handles input validation, partition size calculations, and writes the U-Boot, boot filesystem, and root filesystem images to the target device.
external_files: Partition table generation utility invoked in the script
external_methods: Partition table creation command used with various options

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution logic of the shell script, handling argument validation, partition setup, and image writing.
